summary: Describes the RTP payload format for carrying JPEG-compressed video streams. It splits JPEG frames into packets for real-time delivery. It is a proposed standard and replaces RFC 2035.

eli5.summary: A video is a quick series of pictures. This says how to cut each JPEG picture into pieces for sending and how to put it together again.
